sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the plating-owner materialApprovalStatus sh:class nltl:evidenceState and the conditional requirement that corrosionAbrasionAddition below 2 mm requires both specialSurfaceCoatingMaintained=true and nltl:evidenceStateApproved. Repair the corrosion alternatives: sh:minInclusive, sh:maxExclusive, and the exact 2 mm comparison currently target the QuantityValue node rather than qudt:numericValue; constrain the nested numericValue instead, using equal inclusive bounds (minInclusive 2 and maxInclusive 2) for the normal 2 mm alternative and maxExclusive 2 for the approved lower-value alternative. Also add an explicit zero-denominator guard for spacing before or alongside the h/s calculation so spacing=0 cannot produce an unbound ratio and accidentally pass.
